projectsData.title: SALES ANALYSIS DASHBOARD
projectsData.subtitle: Interactive Revenue & Performance Visualizer
projectsData.description: Comprehensive Power BI sales analysis dashboard tracking enterprise revenue trends, regional performance, product margins, and customer demographic insights.

fullDetails.overview: This project transforms complex multi-region transactional sales data into a dynamic executive dashboard. Users can filter by time period, product category, customer segment, and region to reveal profitability drivers and sales pipeline bottlenecks.
keyFeatures: Interactive dynamic filtering across region, product family, and quarterly performance
DAX measures calculating Year-over-Year (YoY) revenue growth and gross profit margins
Automated Excel data refresh pipeline connected to central SQL server
Executive KPI cards highlighting top-performing products and underperforming territories
fullDetails.architecture: Excel -> SQL Server -> Power BI DAX Engine -> Executive View

projectsData.title: LOGISTICS ANALYTICS - OTIF
projectsData.subtitle: Supply Chain & On-Time In-Full Monitor
projectsData.description: End-to-end supply chain On-Time In-Full (OTIF) analytics solution evaluating dispatch efficiency, transit delay patterns, and warehouse fulfillment SLA compliance.

fullDetails.overview: A dedicated supply chain intelligence dashboard built for logistics operators. It tracks shipment trajectories from warehouse dispatch to end destination, identifying root causes for delivery delays and inventory stockouts.
keyFeatures: Real-time OTIF percentage calculation against strict customer SLA thresholds
Root-cause delay categorization (Warehouse Hold, Transit Delay, Customs Clearance)
Carrier reliability scoring matrix comparing external 3PL logistics vendors
Geographic heat map highlighting high-congestion transport corridors
fullDetails.architecture: PostgreSQL -> Python ETL -> Power BI Gateway -> Operational Dashboard
